verdict.rationale: Moss documents semantic similarity search over embeddings, either built-in on-device or bring-your-own vectors via a `custom` model, with sub-10ms queries. That covers the core of searching over embeddings. However, the docs never mention approximate nearest-neighbor indexing or any way to configure the distance metric; the hybrid `alpha` weighting and `min_score` threshold are related controls, not metric selection. Missing for 10: configurable distance metrics (cosine/dot/L2), explicit ANN index documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run approximate nearest-neighbor similarity search over embeddings with configurable distance metrics
